name: Hockey Scoreboard
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Live, recent, and upcoming hockey games across NHL, NCAA Men's, and NCAA Women's hockey with real-time scores and schedules

assets.logos: Uses shared LEDMatrix assets/sports/nhl_logos and assets/sports/ncaa_logos directories

api_requirements.name: ESPN API
api_requirements.description: ESPN public API for NHL and NCAA hockey scores and schedules
api_requirements.rate_limit: No official rate limit, but please use responsibly

versions.notes: Correct the NCAA women's hockey example team codes in the favorite-teams help text: Wisconsin is WIS in ESPN's data, not WISC. Copying the old example matched no team and showed nothing.

Fix event start times rendering in UTC. The plugin looked for the LEDMatrix global timezone only on cache_manager.config_manager; on cores that expose config_manager via the plugin manager instead, that lookup found nothing and every start time was drawn in UTC even though the clock plugin was correct on the same device. Timezone resolution now checks the plugin override, then both config managers, then the host system zone, before falling back to UTC. Adds a documented timezone setting under Advanced Settings -- previously the key was not in the config schema, so hand-editing it had no effect.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed. Also enables the NHL league block by default so a fresh install shows games immediately (matching the other scoreboards).

Add display_durations.non_favorite_live per league: give live games without a favorite team a shorter on-screen turn than your favorites. Applies only when favorite teams are set and show_favorite_teams_only is off; defaults to 0 (off) for unchanged behavior.

Add exclude_teams (hide specific teams from live rotation and recent/final scores - spoiler protection) and favorite_live_boost (tune how much more often your favorite's live game appears in rotation vs other live games) per league (nhl, ncaa_mens, ncaa_womens).
